findings.title: v8x pinned-volume drift gate is blind to injected duplicate bar rows (zip-truncation)
findings.detail: scripts/v8x_crypto_universe_selection.py median_daily_quote_volume_pre_window(): slot_opens_from_ts_event returns np.unique() slot opens, then zip(opens, qv) pairs unique opens with per-ROW volumes, truncating to the unique count. A7 proved: duplicating EVERY pre-window bar of a symbol (192 rows in, daily totals nominally doubled) still yields median_daily_quote_volume_usdt_exact == '24048.0' and gate PASS. The drift gate catches ALTERED volume values (shipped mutation test passes) but not injected rows. This file is sha-verified UNTOUCHED by the candidate (709b40c2...); repairing it would violate the cycle's historical-immutability contract.
findings.recommendation: Follow-up cycle: compute per-row slot opens without dedup (or assert len(opens)==len(qv)) before summing, and add a duplicate-ts_event integrity assertion to the v9 census.

findings.title: EVENT_LOG_REWRITTEN check is vacuous when the log file is absent at the anchor
findings.detail: _is_line_prefix([], tip_lines) is True for ANY tip content, so a journal/event log CREATED after the anchor can be arbitrarily rewritten without detection. A7 reproduced this in a synthetic repo (journal absent at anchor, appended then rewritten -> no finding). Real-world exposure is nil for the audited anchors: A7 verified plans/CYCLE_REGISTRY.events.jsonl and research/control/market_data_plane_v2_run/event_log.jsonl both EXIST at 41bf9b1 and satisfy the byte-prefix property at 597e74c.
findings.recommendation: Raise a finding when an append-only log path is absent at the anchor but present at the tip (creation-after-anchor should itself be an explicit, allowlist-judged event).
